Message: I shall save the world with my life.

How beautiful those words
sound in my heart.
But the relic that is
meant to save the world,
the Lance of Longinus,
no longer answers my prayers.

A soul on the verge of decay
has no right to have their
feeble words heard, after all.

I happened to hear quite the
intriguing tale from Lady Rosalie.

About those who contract
with angels—apostles.
And...those who contract
with demons—acolytes.

...Then, an utterly foolish idea
came drifting into my mind.

However, another truth
had also dawned upon me.
That, even after everything
I had done, I was still afraid
to sully my own hands.

Even though the only end
befitting of someone like me...
is one so revolting that everyone
will turn their eyes away.

Thus, I shall take the first step...
Down the path towards
sullying my hands...
to save the world.
